name: How long does appliance-area preparation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does appliance-area preparation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of appliance-area preparation varies significantly depending on the complexity of the work. Simple preparations, like minor electrical adjustments, might take a few hours. More extensive projects, such as structural modifications or rerouting significant plumbing/gas lines, could take several days. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific needs.
